inputs.format: LE binary32 row-major; A[M,K], T[2*1024,K], C=A*T^T

protocol.criterion: smallest ordered shape where resident median GPU E2E / median CPU E2E < 0.90
protocol.e2e: accept caller query through full synchronous host copy, before full comparison
protocol.pair_order: CPU-GPU, GPU-CPU alternating. Timed banks 0,1,1,0 twice.
protocol.stream: CPU reads caller-contiguous query directly; GPU copies it into one reusable shared buffer
